blocks.text: The VDI Device Groups page displays a list of predefined Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) device groups. The VDI devices that have Zscaler Client Connector for VDI deployed are categorized under respective groups based on their OS type.
The VDI Device Groups page provides you with the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Apply Internet & SaaS (ZIA) security policies to many VDI devices at once.
View the details of the VDI devices contained in a predefined VDI group.

blocks.heading: About the VDI Device Groups Page

blocks.text: On the VDI Device Groups page (Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet & SaaS Device Management > VDI Device Groups), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a VDI device group.
Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all configured VDI device groups. For each VDI device group, you can view the following information:
Group Name: The name of the VDI device group.
OS Type: The OS type of the VDI device.
No. of Devices: The number of devices belonging to the VDI device group.
Description: The description of the VDI device
View more information about the VDI device group.
Go to the Devices, Device Groups, and VDI Devices pages.
